Authored Python interpretation runner under tools/symbol-db/interpret/: db.py (SQLite read/write helpers + InterpretationHistory), topology.py (Tarjan-based leaves-first ordering with self-loops dropped to avoid VBA return-value false-cycles), parsing.py (defensive JSON-block extraction with fenced/bare/last-brace fallback), prompt_builder.py (per-kind template renderer), runner.py (interpret_module + interpret_macros + interpret_lookup_tables), __main__.py (CLI), and interpretation-config.json (thresholds + per-kind complexity hints).

Implemented Tarjan-based leaves-first topological sort. Multi-node SCCs are emitted as cycle units and tagged so InterpretationHistory.reason marks them as first-pass cycle members. Single-node self-loops are filtered before scheduling because in VBA they almost always represent the function-name return-value pattern, not real recursion. Verified on a 4-function/49-enum-value modStrings schedule.

Authored eight per-kind prompt templates (function_sub, property, module_var, enum_decl, enum_value, macro, lookup_table, query) plus a shared header that defines the structured-JSON response contract. Non-leaf templates include a "Callee summaries" block that is populated from already-interpreted callees rather than re-walking source.

Wired confidence-thresholded escalation: opinion 2 fires when Confidence1 < 0.75; opinion 3 when avg(Conf1, Conf2) < 0.70. Thresholds live in tools/symbol-db/interpretation-config.json. Per-opinion calls go through the standard route() rotation so opinion 2 lands on a different cross-provider verifier than opinion 1 by virtue of the rule-based selector.

Implemented post-pass copy of Interpretation1 from canonical twins to MD5-equivalent siblings (reason="copied-from-md5-twin"). NorthwindDevEdition's probe modules contain zero hash-twin clusters per Session 1 measurement, so this run produced 0 copies; the path is exercised by the unit tests in interpret/tests/.
